answer: Sybil farms spin cheap clones before rewards settle. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 64-byte kernel commitment tied to its first-final parent set; peers then require a fresh echo of kernel hashed with the public epoch salt inside a 14h horizon before mint eligibility. Cost is one extra hash round plus wait. Verification: attestors recompute kernel||salt and match the echo txid. Failure: no echo past the horizon or a reused kernel across invite roots freezes the identity for 3 epochs and withholds emission.
